==Description==
The '''Xmas 2019 Crate''' is an exclusive [[Crates|crate]] that was only purchasable during the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. Unlike the [[Halloween 2019 Crate]], this crate only gives 4 skins as opposed to the [[Halloween 2019 Crate]]'s 9 skins. However, this crate was slightly more expensive at a cost of {{Coins|4,500}}.

==Appearance==
{{Tabber
|Current
|The '''Xmas 2019 Crate''' resembles the look of an green, blue and grey wooden box which was sealed shut. It contains gold on the inside. On its top is the standard shipping symbol indicating which side is up while on the front it had a Christmas tree. It was opened with a crowbar.
|Version 2
|The second appearance of the '''Xmas 2019 Crate''' was similar to the [[Basic Crate]]. It was a green cardboard box with an aqua green tape to seal it shut. On its side is a decorated Christmas tree decal.
|Version 1
|The first appearance of the '''Xmas 2019 Crate''' was similar to the [[Platinum Crate]]. Instead of being blue, the crate was green with a yellow keyhole. A mistletoe was also attached to the top of the crate.
}}
